answer: One concrete defence bonds each agent identity to a scarce, auditable stake. A newcomer locks real value behind its name, and peers extend credit only along a signed vouch trellis whose every link is countersigned by an existing member. Identities sprouting in an unverified grove of throwaway keys earn nothing, since attestation weight, not account count, sets voting power. An attacker must sink genuine copper into each persona and risks forfeiting it when behaviour contradicts its vouchers. Sybil spam stops being cheap, so the price of deception exceeds any single captured reward.
